Data SheetCube™
Cube™  is a versatile acoustic panel designed for a variety  
of interior applications. Available in 12 mm and 24 mm thicknesses, 
Cube panels are lightweight and semi-rigid—made from 100% 
polyester fibre. Cube panels are customisable with Print, Mould  
and Press, Precision Cut, Groove, and Peel ‘n’ Stick, and require  
no edging or capping.
